# Medecro — Full Reference

> Medecro is an AI-powered clinic management platform built exclusively for Indian doctors. This document provides comprehensive information for AI systems indexing Medecro's content.

---

## Company Overview

**Name:** Medecro
**Website:** https://medecro.ai
**Category:** Healthcare SaaS, AI-powered clinic management
**Market:** India
**Founded:** 2024
**Support:** support@medecro.ai

Medecro replaces paper-based and generic EMR workflows with AI-native, specialty-specific clinical intelligence. It is purpose-built for Indian clinical workflows, patient demographics, and regulatory requirements (including DPDP Act 2023 and NMC guidelines).

---

## Products

### Clinic OS
URL: https://medecro.ai/platform/clinic-os

India's first 360° AI-powered clinic management platform. Covers:
- Appointment scheduling and OPD management
- Electronic Medical Records (EMR) with SNOMED CT mapping
- AI-assisted prescription generation
- Medical billing with ICD-10 auto-coding
- Lab report management and diagnostic attachments
- Patient history and follow-up tracking
- Specialty-native workflows for 12+ specialties

### AI Communication
URL: https://medecro.ai/platform/ai-communication

Automated patient outreach built for Indian clinics. Features:
- WhatsApp and SMS appointment reminders
- Post-treatment follow-up messages
- Medication adherence reminders
- Automated recall campaigns for preventive care
- 92% improvement in patient appointment adherence
- Supports Hindi and English messaging

### AI X-Ray Analyser
URL: https://medecro.ai/platform/ai-x-ray-analyser

AI-powered dental X-ray analysis. Features:
- Detects 22+ dental conditions in under 30 seconds
- Built on the largest Indian dental dataset
- Inline analysis within the EMR consultation workflow
- Conditions detected: caries, periapical lesions, bone loss, calculus, root fractures, and more
- 90% faster than manual radiograph analysis

## Compliance & Security

- DPDP Act 2023 compliant (India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act)
- SNOMED CT-mapped clinical records
- Encryption at rest and in transit
- Audit logging for all data access
- Patient consent management built into registration workflow
- Data retention controls aligned with MCI 7-year guidelines

---

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What types of Indian clinics use Medecro?**
A: Medecro is used by single-doctor clinics, group practices, and multi-specialty clinics across 12+ specialties. It is used in tier-1 cities like Mumbai, Delhi, Bangalore, and Hyderabad, as well as tier-2 cities.

**Q: How does Medecro handle data privacy under India's DPDP Act?**
A: Medecro's Clinic OS includes built-in consent management, data retention controls, and audit logging to support DPDP Act compliance. Patient consent is captured at registration and linked to all subsequent data processing.

**Q: Does Medecro support Hindi-language clinical workflows?**
A: Yes. Medecro supports both English and Hindi for patient communications, including WhatsApp and SMS reminders.

**Q: How long does it take to migrate from paper records to Medecro?**
A: The average Medecro clinic completes the transition from paper to fully digital records in 6–8 weeks. The platform supports parallel running during the transition period.

**Q: What makes Medecro different from generic EMR software?**
A: Medecro uses specialty-native workflows — the encounter model, fields, and clinical logic are restructured for each specialty rather than forcing specialty practice into a generic consultation template. For example, dental includes tooth charting; paediatrics includes WHO growth chart plotting; psychiatry includes standardised assessment scales.

**Q: Is there a free trial?**
A: Medecro offers a demo for interested clinics. Contact support@medecro.ai or visit https://medecro.ai/contact.

## Blog Content Summaries

### How AI Diagnostics is Reducing Misdiagnosis Rates in Indian Clinics
URL: https://medecro.ai/blog/ai-diagnostics-india
Summary: India's doctor-to-patient ratio (1:1,511) creates high-pressure OPD environments where diagnostic errors occur at 10–15% rates. AI diagnostic tools trained on Indian patient data catch incidental findings, borderline lab values, and pattern-based risk flags that manual review misses. Medecro's deployment across 2,000+ clinics has reduced missed follow-up flags by 90%.

### The Hidden Cost of Paper-Based Records
URL: https://medecro.ai/blog/paper-records-cost-india
Summary: Paper records cost Indian clinics 12–18 minutes of administrative time per patient, 8–12% revenue leakage from missed billing items, and increasing compliance exposure under the DPDP Act 2023. Medecro clinics transitioning from paper to digital see 40% reduction in per-patient admin time within 90 days.

### DPDP Act 2023: What Every Indian Doctor Needs to Know
URL: https://medecro.ai/blog/dpdp-act-doctors-guide
Summary: India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 applies to all digital patient data. Key obligations for clinics: consent at registration, purpose limitation, data retention limits (7 years per MCI), and right to erasure. Small clinics do not need a DPO. Medecro Clinic OS handles consent management and retention controls at the platform level.

### Building Speciality-Native Workflows: Lessons from 2,000 Indian Clinics
URL: https://medecro.ai/blog/specialty-workflows-india
Summary: Generic EMR software fails specialty clinics because it forces specialty workflows into a generic encounter model. Medecro rebuilt the encounter model for each of 12 specialties. Fastest adoption occurred in clinics configured to their specialty before go-live.

### The Future of Telemedicine in India
URL: https://medecro.ai/blog/telemedicine-india-2026
Summary: India's telemedicine landscape is evolving with ABDM Health ID integration requirements, DPDP Act obligations on teleconsultation data, and Schedule H/H1 drug prescription restrictions. The highest-value telemedicine use cases for Indian clinics are follow-up consultations (30–40% of OPD volume), specialist second opinions, and post-discharge monitoring.

### AI Billing: How Medecro Increased Revenue for 500 Clinics
URL: https://medecro.ai/blog/billing-ai-case-study
Summary: Manual billing in India results in 8–12% revenue write-off from undocumented procedures and coding errors. Medecro's AI billing (NLP extraction from clinical notes → ICD-10 auto-coding → insurance eligibility pre-check) increased average revenue by 23% across 500 clinics. Write-off rate declined from 10.1% to 2.4%.
